note: Op-replay conformance corpus assembled from the per-family non-circular oracles (tools/*_oracle.py). Every expected value traces to an RFC/FIPS/NIST vector or a from-scratch constructor, never to an implementation under test (F3). Driven through each SDK adapter by harness/runner (naalp-conform). cose.sign1 is graded by the crypto-consensus gate, not here.

deterministic composite value mldsaSig||edSig; Go==Rust==Python byte-parity (consensus)

idle+open(not-auth) -- idle | StreamOpen (effect not authorized) | reject (EffectNotAuthorized)
open+expire -- open | expire (timer) | -> abandoned [Stream idle/commit timer]
expire-on-committed -- committed | expire | reject (StreamStateError) [timer cleared on commit]
establish-skip-to-target -- <unseen> | update(2) | -> persisted_target [establish; first update may report any stage]
expiry-over-consume -- precedence: past not_after AND already consumed -> ApprovalExpired (ledger untouched), never AlreadyConsumed
mismatch-fresh -- precedence: args-content-id mismatch -> ApprovalMismatch (over every cell)
mismatch-over-consumed -- precedence: mismatch checked before the ledger -> ApprovalMismatch, not AlreadyConsumed
mismatch-over-expired -- precedence: mismatch checked before expiry -> ApprovalMismatch, not ApprovalExpired
reject-then-valid -- a rejected request leaves the ledger untouched -> a later valid consume still succeeds
success-mismatch-already -- consumed | consume | reject (AlreadyConsumed) after an intervening rejected mismatch
depth_over: payload item at depth 17 > MAX_NESTING_DEPTH 16
size_over: adapter passes MAX_OBJECT_SIZE+1 raw bytes to verify; rejected on length before parse
float_body: body field 10 is a CBOR float (major 7); forbidden (§3.1.1, R5)
float_ext: ext (field 11) key 100 value is a CBOR float; forbidden (§3.1.1, R5)
float_cext: cext (field 12) key 100 value is a CBOR float; forbidden (§3.1.1, R5)
dupkey_ext: ext (field 11) is a map with two identical keys (RFC 8949 §5.6, §3.1.1)
protected_0x41a0: empty protected header encoded 0x41A0 (bstr-wrapped empty map) not 0x40 (§3.1.1, R5)
chunks_over: adapter materializes MAX_STREAM_CHUNKS+1 empty chunks + a matching commit; count check fires before the digest check
code=22 (BadSignature) but name=NotDelivered: registered code + wrong name -> Malformed
unknown code is opaque and non-fatal (open registry, RFC Required)
add-chain-valid -- collecting | add-chain (valid link, no equivocation) | -> collecting
add-chain-chainbroken -- collecting | add-chain (broken prev/seq link) | reject (ChainBroken)
add-chain-equivocation -- collecting | add-chain (two receipts, one seq, different objects) | reject (Equivocation)
add-chain-receiptunsigned -- collecting | add-chain (receipt signature does not verify) | reject (ReceiptUnsigned)
linearize-valid -- collecting | linearize (union causal graph acyclic, no future-cause) | -> linearized
linearize-causalviolation -- collecting | linearize (cycle or future-cause in the merged graph) | reject (CausalViolation)
verify-agrees -- linearized | verify (independent recomputation agrees) | -> verified
verify-reconcilemismatch -- linearized | verify (independent recomputation disagrees) | reject (ReconcileMismatch)
